_about: Staged transcription of the status guide screenshots. `name` is the heading exactly as written; `description` is the definition exactly as written (null when the guide only lists the name). Classification comes from the section heading the entry sits under. `modifiers` are added only where the wording is unambiguous: a named stat, a direction and (when given) a number. A modifier's `magnitude` is the guide's DEFAULT; an individual ninja's text may override it. This is reference text, not a combat formula. `note` is a reviewer note shown in the Spanish interface, so it is written in Spanish; game terms inside it stay in English.

entries.name: Penetration or Pierce damage
entries.description: Immediate deduction of enemy hp equal to the attacker's attack stat (and attack reduction effects do affect it)

entries.name: DoT (damage over time)
entries.description: Deduction of enemy hp equal to the attacker's attack stat at the start of the enemy's turn (and attack reduction effects do affect it)
entries.timingNote: at the start of the enemy's turn

entries.name: Physical or strategy defense shield
entries.description: A certain percentage of your physical or strategy defense value respectively is used to reduce direct or DoT damage taken. Physical shield scales on physical defense, so Jōgan is best suited for physical ninjas. Strategy shield scales on strategy defense, so Tenseigan is better suited for strategic ninjas.

defaults.note: La guía lista los DoT en su propio apartado, separado de los «debuffs», y solo da el nombre, sin definición.

entries.name: Sticky acid
entries.description: bypasses the effect of DoT-reducing bloodlines (Jōgan and Tenseigan) and defense shields (e.g. Summer Pain and Hashirama-Madara)
entries.note: Aparece como punto aparte bajo «Cleansable DoTs», después de la lista. Se clasifica como DoT purificable solo por esa posición. La excepción se guarda como texto; no se calcula nada a partir de ella.

defaults.note: La guía lista los DoT en su propio apartado, separado de los «debuffs», y solo da el nombre, sin definición.
La guía lista los CC en su propio apartado, separado de los «debuffs», y solo da el nombre, sin definición.

entries.name: Charm
entries.description: with chaos effect whose potency varies among ninjas who apply it
entries.note: La guía lista los CC en su propio apartado, separado de los «debuffs». El texto entre paréntesis es la única definición que da.

entries.name: Painful Will
entries.description: Unable to add buffs

entries.name: Upwind/Headwind state
entries.description: Decreases healing rate and CC resistance by 30%

entries.name: Weakened state
entries.description: Decreases speed and defenses by 20% and unable to add buffs
entries.note: También impide añadir buffs; esa parte se guarda solo como texto.

entries.name: Corrosion state
entries.description: Decreases avoid injury and increases final damage received (30%, unless other is stated)

entries.name: Death Seed
entries.description: Instant death at the start of your turn (unless the ninja is immune)
entries.timingNote: at the start of your turn

entries.name: Poisonous Wind
entries.description: Uncleansable CC and 30% subtraction of current hp at the start of your turn
entries.timingNote: at the start of your turn
entries.note: Se describe como CC pero aparece en la lista de debuffs, no en la de CC. El 30% de la vida actual se guarda como texto: es una pérdida de vida, no un modificador de estadística.

entries.name: Curse Fixation
entries.description: Uncleansable CC and 20% block rate reduction
entries.note: Aparece dos veces en la guía: solo con el nombre en «Uncleansable CCs» y con esta definición en «Uncleansable debuffs». Una única entrada recoge ambas clasificaciones.

entries.name: Chaotic Storm
entries.description: Decreases enemy attack and defenses (20%, unless other is stated)

entries.name: Dispirited State
entries.description: Decreases damage rate and final damage (25%, unless other is stated)

entries.name: Untreatment State
entries.description: Cannot be healed

entries.name: Armor Break
entries.description: Defenses reduction (30%, unless other is stated)

entries.name: Crit resistance reduction
entries.description: as implied (20%, unless other is stated)
entries.sourceText: Crit resistance reduction: as implied (20%, u… other is stated)
entries.ambiguityNote: An on-screen scroll button covers part of this line. The visible text is 'as implied (20%, u… other is stated)'; 'unless' is read from the identical phrase used by the other entries.

entries.name: S-Super Dodge
entries.description: Protects from all incoming damage, debuffs, dots, penetration damage, and fury reduction effects (unless the attacking enemy is immune to S-Super Dodge. If the enemy is immune to S-Super Dodge, this buff can be cleansed (e.g. Hiruko))
entries.cleansabilityNote: If the enemy is immune to S-Super Dodge, this buff can be cleansed (e.g. Hiruko)

entries.name: Amenotejikara/Shielding state/Position Interchange
entries.description: Ignores enemy damage (only direct damage from skill, not s.crit, s.block, penetration damage, DoTs, or poisonous wind)
entries.note: «Shielding state» es también el título de otra entrada de la misma lista, con una definición más corta. Se conservan las dos tal como están escritas.

entries.name: Shatter Storm/Breaking Wind
entries.description: Increases attack and defenses by 15% (unless other is stated)
entries.note: Regla confirmada por el cliente: un porcentaje entre paréntesis en el texto de un ninja (por ejemplo «(20%) shatter storm») sustituye a este 15% solo para ese ninja. Es la fuerza del efecto, no una probabilidad.

entries.name: Wind Escape/Shield
entries.description: Ignores enemy attack by 10%
entries.ambiguityNote: 'Wind Escape/Shield' may mean 'Wind Escape / Wind Shield' or 'Wind Escape / Shield'; only 'Wind Escape' is recorded as an alias. This heading is not in bold in the source. 'Ignores enemy attack by 10%' is kept as text: what exactly is reduced is not clear enough to structure.

entries.name: Shielding state
entries.description: Ignores enemy damage
entries.note: Las mismas palabras aparecen dentro del título «Amenotejikara/Shielding state/Position Interchange», cuya definición es más restrictiva. Se conserva como entrada propia, tal como está escrita.

entries.name: Bond state
entries.description: Increases CC resistance, block rate (can exceed cap), and avoid injury by 35%

entries.name: Pyroblast state
entries.description: Increases damage rate and final damage dealt by 30%

entries.name: Superarmor state
entries.description: Immunity to debuffs

entries.name: Acceleration
entries.description: Increases speed by 15%

entries.name: Strong state
entries.description: Increases avoid injury and final damage reduction
entries.note: La guía no indica ningún valor para este estado.

entries.name: Super Defense
entries.description: Increases defenses (20%, unless other is stated)

entries.name: Super dodge
entries.description: Protects from all incoming damage, debuffs, dots, penetration damage, and fury reduction effects (unless the attacking enemy is immune to Super Dodge)

entries.name: Fury Shield
entries.description: Increases final damage dealt by 30%

entries.name: CC-free State
entries.description: Immunity to all CC

entries.name: Death Seed immunity buff
entries.description: Protects from Death Seed application
